By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a '''consortium of alien''' [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] were offering ancient devices at an auction. Eventually, someone was sent to investigate the artifacts and discovered that among the auction's items there were religious relics of long-dead cultures.<ref name="ARCH">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaelogy|The Consortium}}</ref>
